# Clean Docs - Documentation Quality Validator

## Overview
A Python CLI tool for validating documentation quality. Checks code snippets against source code, detects broken links, auto-fixes issues, and integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines.

## Key Features
- Code snippet validation using tree-sitter
- Broken link detection
- Auto-fix capabilities
- CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
- Multi-format support (Markdown, HTML, RST)
- Batch processing

## Documentation
https://algiras.github.io/clean-docs/

## Repository
https://github.com/Algiras/clean-docs

## Installation
Available on PyPI: `pip install clean-docs`

## Use Cases
- Maintaining documentation accuracy
- Preventing outdated code examples
- Automated documentation validation
- Quality gates in CI/CD
- Documentation consistency checks

## Technologies
- Python 3.10+
- Tree-sitter parsing
- GitHub Actions integration
- Available as Claude Code skill
